recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Body: Clive de Carle has spent decades researching high-quality natural health essentials, from magnesium and fulvic minerals to iodine, selenium, and vegan-sourced vitamin D. His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Role: Co-host of Vibe Rant; teacher of occult symbolism & tarot

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Heather's Dreamspell and Natural Time", "body": "Heather Elizabeth introduced herself as a shamanic energy medicine practitioner initiated into the 13 Moon Dreamspell, which she described as a kind of astrology interwoven with Mayan cosmology. In her view it was a navigation tool for dreaming reality consciously. Chance said he was convinced the calendar mapped synchronicity and offered a simpler zodiac for most people. Heather explained that she held a circle every 13 days, on the crystal tone days, and said the system invited people to move from artificial time into natural time."}, {"title": "Galactic Signatures and a Red Cosmic Moon", "body": "Chance shared his own signature, white magnetic mirror, and showed a lookup tool so listeners could decode their birthdays. Heather explained her view that twenty tribes and thirteen tones combined into signatures, and that the full moon in Leo fell on a red cosmic moon day. She said the tribe carried the power of universal water and called listeners toward emotional presence and trust in intuition. Chance read the riddle for the day aloud, and chat members posted their own signatures for Heather to comment on."}, {"title": "Harmonic Convergence and the Seed Year", "body": "Heather said the Day Out of Time carried forward the spirit of the Harmonic Convergence of August 1987, which she described as a worldwide meditation for peace. She said the dream spell's mantra was that time is art. Asked about the year, she explained that the current year was the yellow electric seed, which she read as a call to plant seeds of service for generations to come. Heather noted that the signature last appeared fifty two years earlier, and Chance linked fifty two to the weeks and cards of a year."}, {"title": "Number, Language, and Artificial Time", "body": "Chance asked whether the calendar rested on a different mathematical base, and Heather said she saw it reflected in the body, with twenty digits and thirteen major joints. Chance showed the Dresden Codex, and Heather explained that Mayan dots counted as one and bars as five. Chance argued that numbers once carried spiritual significance, and that language and number worked as operating systems. Heather argued that the Gregorian calendar and the clock had pulled people out of sync with nature, and said aligning with natural time brought harmony. Gabe later described his own effort to decolonize his thinking through wordplay."}, {"title": "The Metonic Cycle and Reversed Luminaries", "body": "Chance read an explanation of the metonic cycle, about nineteen years, and said he had heard that some researchers tied it to a thirteen month calendar. He observed that the September 2001 to September 2020 span matched one such cycle. Gabe spoke about tarot, saying the date 216 encoded two towers like those on the moon card. One of the hosts then proposed that tarot had the sun and moon reversed. Heather said she was attached to the moon as feminine, but would meditate on the idea."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Heather Elizabeth is a full-time existence explorer and creator of the consciousness shift that humanity currently requires in our collective spiritual evolution. As an energy healer trained in shamanic modalities and galactic cartographer adept in the 13 Moon Dreamspell calendar, Heather joins us to inspire our timekeeping into alignment with the Galactic Mayan zodiacal code.
